MR Safety
The Rhea Transcatheter Valve is MR Conditional. A person with the Rhea Transcatheter Valve may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Rhea Transcatheter Valve
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 3.0 Tesla only
MR Scanner Type Cylindrical
B0 Field Orientation Horizontal
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 7.2 T/m (720 G/cm)
RF Excitation Circularly Polarized (CP)
RF Receive Coil Type Any
RF Conditions B1+RMS of 1.5 microtesla or less; when B1+rms is not displayed, use a whole body SAR of 1.2 W/kg or less
Scan Duration Maximum active scan time of 20 minutes.
